title: Fix 'Secrets were required, but not provided' error
summary: This error occurs when NetworkManager fails to authenticate with a Wi-Fi network, often due to a timeout or incorrect password. Recreating the connection profile usually fixes it.

aliases.text: secrets were required but not provided

error_patterns: Secrets were required, but not provided

steps.explain: Delete the existing connection profile for the Wi-Fi network.
